full_prompt_en: A humorous editorial painting shows a crowded committee meeting in a cramped pale-blue room. An older man in a teal jacket bends over a table and writes on a large sheet of paper, while another man in glasses studies the document beside him. Around them, seven more adults press forward in layered rows, each with a different worried or suspicious expression. Their noses, ears, and brows are exaggerated into rounded caricature, and a black-and-tan dog peers toward the paper from the right. A small gray mouse sits on the tabletop near the dog. Papers are tacked unevenly to the wall behind, adding context without pulling attention from the collective gaze toward the center. The heads form a tight irregular arch above the rectangular gray table. Warm rosy flesh and mustard accents stand out against muted teal, slate, olive, and blue-gray clothing. The drawing is precise but softened by painted shading: fine contours define faces and suits, while short brush marks model cheeks, wrinkles, fabric, and the dog's coat. Light is even and cool, with slightly warmer illumination on the foreground faces and paper. Shadows stay shallow, so the many individual characters remain legible despite the compression. The composition is deliberately claustrophobic, yet the broad plain table and bright paper provide a visual resting place. Its comedy comes from the earnest concentration of so many distinct figures on one small problem.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅幽默编辑绘画呈现狭窄浅蓝房间里的拥挤委员会会议。一位穿青绿外套的年长男子伏在桌前，向大纸上写字，身边戴眼镜男子研究文件。周围另有七名成人在层叠队列中向前挤，各带不同的担忧或怀疑表情。他们的鼻、耳与眉被夸张成圆润漫画形，一只黑褐狗从右侧向纸张探看。小灰鼠坐在狗旁桌面上。纸张不整齐地钉在后墙，补充环境而不把注意从众人朝向中央的目光中拉走。头部在矩形灰桌上方形成紧凑而不规则的拱。暖玫瑰肤色与芥黄色强调从压低的青绿、石板色、橄榄及蓝灰衣服中凸显。画法精确，却被绘画性阴影软化：细轮廓界定脸和西装，短笔塑造面颊、皱纹、布料与狗毛。光均匀偏冷，前景脸和纸略偏暖亮。阴影浅，使众多人物虽被压缩仍各自可辨。构图刻意幽闭，但宽而平的桌面与亮纸提供视觉休憩。喜剧感来自这么多不同人物对一个小问题的郑重专注。
style_prompt_en: Painted editorial caricature combines exact but pliant contour with rounded exaggerated forms and softly modeled color. Dusty blue, muted teal, olive, gray, mustard, and warm rose occupy interlocking patches rather than bright flat blocks. Many compact shapes can press together in layered rows, with repeated directional gazes or gestures converging on one lighter central plane. Fine line defines features and seams; short blended strokes give volume to cloth, skin, and small textures. Lighting is broad and even, preserving legibility across a crowded field, while shallow shadows and soft background detail keep the whole scene approachable. A plain rectangular base balances the irregular arch of clustered forms above. The composition feels densely social and gently satirical, its rhythm carried by varied expressions, small color differences, and the contrast between animated detail and one quiet focal area.
style_prompt_zh: 绘制的编辑漫画把准确却灵活的轮廓与圆润夸张形、柔和塑造色结合。灰蓝、暗青绿、橄榄、灰、芥黄和暖玫瑰占互相嵌入的色片，而非明亮平色块。许多紧凑形可在层叠队列中挤近，重复定向目光或手势汇向一块较亮中央平面。细线界定五官与接缝；短而融合的笔触赋予布、皮肤和小纹理体积。光宽而均匀，在拥挤场中保持可读；浅影和柔背景细节使全景亲近。平整矩形基座平衡上方簇群的不规则拱形。构图密集、有人际关系且温和讽刺，节奏由不同表情、小色差和活跃细节与安静焦点区的对比承载。
theme_en: An anxious committee crowds around a document while a dog waits beside the table
theme_zh: 焦虑的委员会挤在文件周围，一只狗等在桌旁
name: Marian Kamensky
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
